source._comment: LIVE. Idaho SoS VoteIdaho absentee dashboard (voteidaho.gov/data-and-dashboards/absentee-tracker/) is powered by Datawrapper charts that expose clean CSV datasets. County x party of returned ballots = chart 5f5QM (ResCountyDesc, Republican, Democratic, Unaffiliated); county totals = 3EDnv (Returned, total_issued, early_voting, total_voted); statewide x party issued/returned = Jgr2z (for the partisan mail chase). Datawrapper bumps the version integer on each update, so resolve the current version from https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/<id>/ then fetch /<id>/<ver>/dataset.csv. Republican->rep, Democratic->dem, Unaffiliated->npa, minor parties->oth.
